name: io.omniplay.netcode
description: omnisense/omniplay inside a Unity server running Netcode for GameObjects: the connection approval that lets a client in when the ticket in its ConnectionData holds for this server (once), and the server's heartbeat to the application. Runs on omniplay/dotnet.

samples.description: A first call (a ticket the PHP application signed, checked by TicketGate: no server, no key) and a bootstrap that starts the server in batch mode or joins one with -address and -ticket.
